Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:175144
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 37070 of 2024
Applicant :- Saida Khatoon

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Shukla,Smita Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sarvesh Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Compliance affidavit filed today by the State is taken on record.

2. Sri Afzal Ahmad, Advocate holding brief of Sri Sarvesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for
informant submits that Sri Sarvesh Kumar Singh has filed his power on behalf of the informant but
his name could not be shown in the cause list, however, he further submits that he is ready to argue
the case.

3. Heard Sri Ashok Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Afzal Ahmad, Advocate holding brief of Sri Sarvesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA, for the State.

4. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No. 195 of 2024, under Sections 498A and 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Ubhaon, District Ballia during pendency of the trial.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present matter along with her other family members including husband of the deceased.

6. He further submits that actually applicant residing separately along with her husband and other family members and this fact is evident from the certificate issued by Gram Pradhan dated 23.08.2024, which is annexed as page no. 55 of the paper book.

7. He next submits that being mother-in-law of the deceased, applicant was not having any concern with her family affairs and it appears that some dispute arose between the husband and the wife thereafter wife consumed some insecticides and died.

8. He further submits, however, during post-mortem report, cause of death of the deceased could not be ascertained and therefore, his viscera was preserved but State has filed viscera report through compliance affidavit dated 04.11.2024 and from its perusal, it also reflects that the deceased died due to consumption of insecticides and therefore, prima facie it appears to be a case of suicidal death.
9.

He further submits that the applicant is a lady and there is no specific allegation against her and she is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 21.07.2024, i.e., for the last more than three months.

10. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant, however, opposed the prayer for bail and submits that applicant is the mother-in-law of the deceased and her daughter-in-law died within seven years of marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that there is specific allegation against her.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. However, daughter-in-law of the applicant died within seven years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.

13. Further, considering the viscera report of the deceased which has been filed by the State through compliance affidavit, the possibility of suicide allegedly committed by the deceased cannot be ruled out at this stage.
14. Further, the applicant is a lady and she is not having any previous criminal history and she is in jail in the present matter since 21.07.2024, i.e., for the last more than three months.

15. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

17. Let the applicant-Saida Khatoon be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
18. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

19. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
